metadata.pr_description:
Several fixes for running via DirectML
Fix empty image generation issue with Flux1
add CPU fallback for unsupported path. Verified the model works on AMD GPUs

review_planner.summary: The changes introduce a new function `is_directml_enabled` in `model_management.py` and modify two other files (`clip_model.py` and `ldm/flux/math.py`) to check this condition.

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Verify that the changes do not introduce any security vulnerabilities, especially related to the new `is_directml_enabled` function and its usage in `clip_model.py` and `ldm/flux/math.py`.

tasks.title: Logic Review
tasks.description: Check the logic of the new `is_directml_enabled` function and ensure it is correctly used in `clip_model.py` and `ldm/flux/math.py`. Verify that the conditional branches behave as expected.

tasks.title: Performance Review
tasks.description: Evaluate the performance impact of the new `is_directml_enabled` function and its usage in `clip_model.py` and `ldm/flux/math.py`. Check if the changes could lead to any performance regressions or improvements.

tasks.title: General Review
tasks.description: Review the overall changes for consistency, code quality, and adherence to best practices. Ensure that the changes are well-documented and that there are no unintended side effects.
